text.p: Cameron Ashley Building Products Inc said Friday it completed the acquisition of certain assets of Boyd Distributors, a division of Ince Holdings Ltd.
Cameron Ashley said it purchased Boyd, which had about $80 million in sales in 1996, for approximately $12 million.
The company said it expects Boyd to contribute about $60 million to $65 million to its revenue base during the remainder of the current fiscal year.

As Cameron Ashley integrates Boyd into its network, it said it will have a neutral to moderately dilutive impact on the second quarter of fiscal 1997 due, in part, to seasonality and is expected to become accretive in the third quarter. The net contribution from Boyd is expected to be $0.07 to $0.10 per share in fiscal 1997, Cameron Ashley said.

Boyd distributes insulation, roofing, vapor barrier and other building materials. Headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, Boyd services over 1,700 retailers through the company's 16 distribution centers located throughout Canada, Cameron Ashley said.
Cameron Ashley said its plan is to increase its presence in Canada within the next two years to 25 to 30 branch locations generating $150 million in sales.
